articles.mainIdea: How The Travelers Companies (TRV) Narrative Is Shifting With New Targets And Reserve Debates
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How The Travelers Companies (TRV) Narrative Is Shifting With New Targets And Reserve Debates. The updated fair value estimate for Travelers Companies has shifted from US$307.18 to US$313.64 per share, putting a fresh spotlight on where analysts think the shares should trade. That move sits against a backdrop of Street research in which several firms have raised price targets by double digit amounts, while at least one has trimmed its view.
